Points à discuter uniquement — aucun ind: Points for discussion only — no hints
Maintien et orientation de l’attention,: Maintenance and orientation of attention, distractibility, forgetting and omissions in activities.
Agitation motrice ou interne et difficul: Motor or internal agitation and difficulty adjusting the level of activity to the situation.
Attente, interruption, parole, décisions: Waiting, interruption, words, decisions or actions undertaken before having been able to postpone them.
Passage de l’intention à l’action, notam: Transition from intention to action, especially when a task is not very stimulating or without a near deadline.
Découpage, séquençage, priorisation et o: Cutting, sequencing, prioritization and concrete organization of tasks.
Maintien temporaire des informations néc: Temporary maintenance of information necessary to follow an instruction or complete an action.
Perception du temps, anticipation des du: Perception of time, anticipation of durations, punctuality and use of deadlines.
Capacité à suspendre une réponse, interr: Ability to pause a response, interrupt an action, or voluntarily move on.
Mobilisation de l’effort et maintien de: Mobilization of effort and maintenance of commitment despite deferred interest or reward.
Fluctuations de disponibilité attentionn: Fluctuations in attentional availability depending on the moment, stimulation and context.
Absorption attentionnelle intense et dif: Intense attentional absorption and possible difficulty noticing time or changing activity.
Présence rapportée de manifestations sim: Reported presence of similar manifestations during childhood and developmental traces available.
Continuité ou réapparition des difficult: Continuity or reappearance of difficulties over time, beyond a one-off episode.
Présence des difficultés dans plusieurs: Presence of difficulties in several environments or types of situations.
Intensité, rapidité et durée des réactio: Intensity, speed and duration of emotional reactions and return to a more stable level.
Stratégies, efforts et soutiens utilisés: Strategies, efforts and supports used to prevent, mask or correct difficulties.
Sommeil et rythmes susceptibles d’influe: Sleep and rhythms likely to influence attention, activation or impulsivity; no ADHD points are added.
Conséquences déclarées sur les études, l: Declared consequences on studies, work, relationships, autonomy or daily life.
Autres explications ou situations à exam: Other explanations or situations to examine with a professional; These answers do not give any ADHD points.
Diversité des sources disponibles : souv: Diversity of available sources: memories, relatives, old documents and observations in several contexts.
Allers-retours sociaux et émotionnels, p: Social and emotional back and forth, sharing, mutual adjustment and understanding of reciprocity.
Utilisation et lecture du regard, des ex: Use and reading of gaze, expressions, gestures, postures and other non-verbal signals.
Interprétation des implicites, intention: Interpretation of implicits, intentions, social rules and changes in meaning depending on the context.
Création, compréhension, ajustement et m: Creation, understanding, adjustment and maintenance of relationships according to situations.
Gestes, paroles, séquences ou façons de: Gestures, words, sequences or repetitive ways of doing things and the functions they can fulfill.
Besoin de prévisibilité, préparation des: Need for predictability, preparation for changes and the effects of unforeseen events.
Intensité, profondeur, place et rôle rég: Intensity, depth, place and regulatory role of particularly vested interests.
Réactions fortes ou coûteuses à certains: Strong or costly reactions to certain sounds, lights, textures, smells or other stimulations.
Perception faible ou recherche de certai: Poor perception or seeking of certain sensory stimulations.
Présence rapportée de particularités sim: Reported presence of similar characteristics during childhood and developmental traces available.
Continuité des particularités au fil du: Continuity of particularities over time despite learning and adaptations.
Présence des particularités dans plusieu: Presence of particularities in several environments or types of situations.
Dissimulation, imitation ou contrôle vol: Concealment, imitation or voluntary control of behavior in order to appear more consistent with expectations.
Stratégies apprises pour comprendre les: Strategies learned to understand situations and support communication or adaptation.
Fatigue, tension, récupération ou perte: Fatigue, tension, recovery or loss of availability associated with adaptation efforts.
Repérage, différenciation et mise en mot: Identification, differentiation and putting into words emotional states.
Perception et interprétation des signaux: Perception and interpretation of internal body signals such as hunger, pain or tension.
Autres explications ou situations à exam: Other explanations or situations to examine with a professional; these answers do not give any TSA points.
Dimension descriptive construite à parti: Descriptive dimension constructed from the concepts provided in this version of the questionnaire.
Chaque réponse calculable produit une va: Each computable response produces an item value. The formulations relating to the same concept are first averaged; the sufficiently informed concepts are then averaged in their dimension. A concept therefore does not carry more weight because it has several formulations.
